Name: EarlyWizardUnlock
Author: cengagar
Description: Junimo Hut — 20,000g; Earth Obelisk — 500,000g; Water Obelisk — 500,000g; Desert Obelisk — 1,000,000g; Island Obelisk — 1,000,000g; Gold Clock — 10,000,000g. This mod makes the Wizard’s building catalog available at the Wizard’s magic pedestal from day one, removing the need to complete the Goblin Problem quest to access these purchases; items still require their normal in‑game cost, though I can provide a no‑cost version on request. It works with existing saves and is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.x, including 1.6.15. This is a new mod that I have tested and confirmed working; if you encounter any issues, please send me a private message and I’ll be happy to help.

Downloads.Description: Unlocks all wizard building at start of game works on all saves.

Manifest.Name: EarlyWizardUnlock
Manifest.Description: Unlocks all 6 Wizard buildings from the magic pedestal from Day 1, without needing to complete the Goblin Problem quest. Unlocked buildings: Earth Obelisk (500,000g), Water Obelisk (500,000g), Desert Obelisk (1,000,000g), Island Obelisk (1,000,000g), Junimo Hut (20,000g), and Gold Clock (10,000,000g). All buildings still cost their normal gold prices - this only removes the quest unlock gate. You can still complete all quests naturally!
Manifest.Author: cengagar
